request.prompt: Which humanoid robots can be purchased in Europe?

result.text:
Several bipedal and human-scale humanoid robots can be purchased, preordered, or sourced through specialized European distributors and direct manufacturers.

Available & Shipping in Europe

Unitree G1 (China / Sourced via European distributors like QUADRUPED.DE or RobotShop)

Type: Compact/Mid-size bipedal humanoid
Estimated Price: From ~∈ 6,399 for entry/basic configurations up to ∈ 23,000 - ∈ 33,000+ for advanced EDU/research variants with high-DOF dexterous hands.
Best for: Research, AI development, and programming.

Fourier Intelligence GR-1 (China / Global & European distribution)

Type: Full-size general-purpose humanoid (165 cm)
Status: Shipping / available via commercial robotics integrators.
Best for: R&D, commercial showcases, and academic laboratories.

Preorder & Upcoming Rollouts in Europe

NEURA Robotics 4NE1 (Germany)

Type: Full-size industrial and domestic humanoid (180 cm, up to 100 kg payload capacity with tactile sensor skin).
Estimated Price: ~∈ 98,000 for single units; scaling down to ~∈ 60,000 for enterprise fleet orders.
Status: Preorders open, with ongoing rollouts targeting industrial and service deployments.

1X Technologies NEO Beta (Norway / US)

Type: Bipedal/wearable-inspired consumer-leaning domestic humanoid.
Status: Pilot testing and phased rollout stages managed directly through 1X Technologies.

Sourcing & Platforms

If you are looking to browse catalog options, compare hardware specs, or request institutional quotes within the EU, platforms like MERA Robotics and RobotShop Europe aggregate active B2B ordering and import channels for these models.

Are you looking for a humanoid robot specifically for academic research/education, industrial automation, or personal/home use?

If you share your budget range or preferred use case, I can point you toward the most practical model.
